<ComponentPreview name="launch-anything" />

<InstallBlock name="launch-anything" />

A reference-based launch film: **1600 frames at 60 fps**, **1920×1080**, **26.67 seconds**.
Nine scenes preserve the reference's order and pacing, from chrome typography to
the sunlit laptop, drifting brand grid, orbital montage, typed address, and closing mark.

The picture is independently reconstructed using React, SVG, a text shader, and
four generated photographic plates. No original video frames are played back.
The photographs, fine product details, brand glyphs, and bundled Manrope font are
approximations of the low-resolution reference, not its original production assets.

## Usage

```tsx
import { Composition } from "remotion";
import {
  LaunchAnything,
  LAUNCH_FRAMES,
  LAUNCH_FPS,
  LAUNCH_WIDTH,
  LAUNCH_HEIGHT,
} from "@/components/remocn/templates/launch-anything";

export const Root = () => (
  <Composition
    id="LaunchAnything"
    component={LaunchAnything}
    durationInFrames={LAUNCH_FRAMES}
    fps={LAUNCH_FPS}
    width={LAUNCH_WIDTH}
    height={LAUNCH_HEIGHT}
    defaultProps={{}}
  />
);
```

## Customize

```tsx
import { staticFile } from "remotion";

<LaunchAnything
  opening="Your next"
  subject="big idea"
  brandUrl="Acme.studio"
  accentColor="#df622b"
  content={{
    proof: "Built for ambitious\nteams",
    industry: "Every ambition",
    promise: "Make your next move.",
    integrations: ["Notion", "Slack", "Linear"],
  }}
  screenImages={{
    dashboard: staticFile("product-dashboard.png"),
    shoppers: staticFile("mobile-app.png"),
  }}
  logos={[staticFile("partner-a.svg"), staticFile("partner-b.svg")]}
  logoSrc={staticFile("brand-mark.svg")}
  audioSrc={staticFile("soundtrack.m4a")}
  volume={0.8}
/>
```

All props are optional. `content` overrides individual headlines, product labels,
and integration names. `screenImages` replaces any of the seven product demonstrations:
`dashboard`, `shoppers`, `exchange`, `builder`, `trading`, `loyalty`, and `integrations`.
Images fill the display using `object-fit: cover`; approximately 1.52:1 images fit best.
The defaults render actual animated interface layers instead of screenshots.

`media` accepts `desk`, `horizon`, `rocket`, and `earth`. The included images are
embedded for a self-contained, offline registry installation. A replacement desk
plate must retain the screen geometry in `scenes/showcase.tsx`, or update those
coordinates to match the new image. Text is fitted to the reference layout; use
short copy to retain its rhythm. The shader intro requires WebGL2.

Audio is optional and the installed template is silent by default. The original
reference soundtrack is not distributed in the registry.

## Scene timing

| Scene | Time | Editable layers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Opening | 0–3.80s | Chrome words, horizon, readiness headline |
| Action | 3.80–5.90s | Sliding headline, glass button, pointer |
| Portal | 5.90–7.33s | Rounded glass aperture and color sweep |
| Showcase | 7.33–15.12s | Continuous camera move, seven product demonstrations |
| Proof | 15.12–17.02s | Floating brand marks and two-line headline |
| Industry | 17.02–20.22s | Dark orbit rims and two title beats |
| Space | 20.22–21.55s | Rocket, distant orbit, Earth and launch headline |
| Address | 21.55–23.72s | Typed domain and blue light sweep |
| Mark | 23.72–26.67s | Slow brand-mark scale-down |

`motion.ts` owns the cut points and camera curve. `scenes/` contains the shots;
`screens.tsx` contains the independently editable product demos. All animation
derives from the current frame, so scrubbing and out-of-order rendering are deterministic.

## Run in this repository

```bash
bun run studio:launch-anything
bun run review:launch-anything
bun run render:launch-anything
```

The Studio composition includes a props schema for copy, colors, media, logos,
screen replacements, and audio. The render writes `out/launch-anything.mp4`.
To compare against a local reference with its soundtrack:

```bash
bun run render:launch-anything --reference-audio=/absolute/path/to/reference.mp4
```

This muxes the reference audio into the local render and trims it to the picture
duration. The reference file and its audio are never added to the public registry.
